where: Section 2, paragraph after the Q formula
problem: The sentence “A high Q gives a tall, narrow peak” is misleading. In the normalised plot the peak height is always 1, and with R fixed the resonant current I₀ = V/R does not depend on Q. High Q sharpens/narrows the curve; it does not by itself make the peak taller.
fix: Say: “A high Q gives a sharper, narrower peak; a low Q gives a broader peak. The peak current itself is I₀ = V/R when R is fixed.”
